topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture themes and outlines the learning objectives regarding cancer evolution, cell of origin, and the tumor microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic selection and epigenetic mechanisms in cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how clonal succession via Darwinian natural selection and non-mutational epigenetic alterations drive tumor development.

topics.label: Stem cell hierarchy and cell of origin in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the cancer stem cell model and examine experimental evidence identifying specific cells of origin in leukemia and colorectal cancer.

topics.label: Microenvironmental promotion, inflammation, and stromal dependence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how environmental promoters, chronic inflammation, and supportive stroma create permissive conditions for tumor outgrowth and therapeutic intervention.

topics.label: Experimental and computational methods for studying tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the sequencing technologies, spatial profiling methods, and computational tools used to investigate tumor evolution and cellular interactions.

topics.label: Synthesis of multi-factor cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic integrates genetic mutations, epigenetic plasticity, cell-of-origin characteristics, and microenvironmental influences into a unified evolutionary model of cancer.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapies.
